_note: Candidate GenAI use cases for the fictional Federal Grants Administration, scored 1 (worst) to 5 (best) with the program owners in a discovery workshop. 'risk' and 'ato_path' are scored so that 5 means LOW risk and an EASY authorization path.

use_cases.name: FOIA intake triage and record search
use_cases.human_decision: FOIA officer makes every search, exemption and release decision
use_cases.baseline: 2,100 requests/yr; median 74 days for complex track; backlog of 380
use_cases.notes: Statutory deadlines and a backlog give a clear metric. Prototype in this repo.

use_cases.name: Grant application completeness check
use_cases.human_decision: Program staff confirm every deficiency notice
use_cases.notes: High volume, checklist-shaped task, low harm if wrong because staff confirm.

use_cases.name: Grantee report summarization and anomaly flags
use_cases.baseline: 1,600 quarterly reports; reviewed by sampling only
use_cases.notes: Report formats vary; needs a data-normalization step first.

use_cases.name: Staff Q&A over grants policy and guidance
use_cases.human_decision: Answers cite source guidance; staff remain responsible
use_cases.baseline: ~900 internal policy questions/month to the policy inbox
use_cases.notes: Fastest to ship; public content only. Good first win while UC1 goes through review.

use_cases.name: Drafting replies to public inquiries
use_cases.human_decision: Staff edit and send every reply
use_cases.notes: Tone and accuracy review needed; reuse the UC4 knowledge base.

use_cases.name: Legacy grants portal code modernization
use_cases.human_decision: Engineers review and merge every change
use_cases.baseline: 180k lines of legacy code; modernization contract underway (FGA-010)
use_cases.notes: Coding agents (e.g. Codex) with the systems integrator; needs the SI's repos and CI.

use_cases.name: Improper-payment risk scoring
use_cases.human_decision: Investigators decide; model output could affect rights
use_cases.notes: High value but rights-impacting; needs a formal impact assessment and much more data work. Phase 3 at earliest.

use_cases.name: Meeting summaries for review panels
use_cases.notes: Easy, but low mission value; bundle with an enterprise rollout rather than build bespoke.
